# Direct Go calls to loGo/s methods with non-nil pointer parameters
# carry the logos nil check [T-Sec5][R-U2]; method values and
# interface calls are the documented hole: they crash with the plain
# runtime error and no logos prefix.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/nilvalues$GOEXE ./g2/cmd

! exec $WORK/bin/nilvalues$GOEXE direct
stderr 'logos: nil from Go value'

! exec $WORK/bin/nilvalues$GOEXE value
stderr 'nil pointer dereference'
! stderr 'logos: nil from Go value'

! exec $WORK/bin/nilvalues$GOEXE iface
stderr 'nil pointer dereference'
! stderr 'logos: nil from Go value'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l2
	./g2
)

-- w/l2/go.mod --
module example.com/l2

go 1.27

-- w/l2/b/b.lgo --
package b

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type Box struct{}

func (b *Box) Set(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

type Setter interface {
	Set(u *User) string
}

-- w/g2/go.mod --
module example.com/g2

go 1.27

-- w/g2/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"example.com/l2/b"
)

func Run(which string) {
	bb := &b.Box{}
	switch which {
	case "direct":
		_ = bb.Set(nil)
	case "value":
		m := bb.Set
		_ = m(nil)
	case "iface":
		var s b.Setter = &b.Box{}
		_ = s.Set(nil)
	}
}

-- w/g2/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"os"

	"example.com/g2/q"
)

func main() {
	q.Run(os.Args[1])
}
